representative_examples.reason: National Tyre Recovery permit variation identifies operator/site/permit and environmental-risk documents, but no row-level observed GHG quantity is established.
North West Recycling draft decision and variation notice are regulatory binding evidence, not measured emissions.
Safran plating-facility consultation provides current installation and permit identity only.
FCC Recycling consultation exposes environmental-risk/site-condition documents while remaining non-measurement evidence.

Net Zero Teesside CCUS application includes emission-point plans, air-quality modelling and test-output files; no parcel GHG row is promoted without validated observed quantity, unit, period and geometry.
L.J. Fairburn intensive-farming application includes BAT and environmental-risk evidence but no observed release row.
O.C.O Technology permit variation supports facility identity/regulatory scope only.
HAWKES application includes energy-efficiency, fugitive-emissions and H1 documents; these remain method/context evidence rather than measured parcel GHG.

promotion_gate: No source-level example can become a measured cadastral parcel greenhouse-gas row unless pollutant/gas, quantity, unit, reporting period, measurement/report method, facility identity and compatible verified parcel geometry are all present and validated.
